purpose: Qualify Prime Agent v0.9.1 as an optional Zetsu agent_task execution harness over Laplace's selected local Qwen3.8-27B P8 service while retaining Laplace repository authorization, candidate assurance, authoritative verification, evidence, and promotion.

production_boundary.prime_role: execution harness inside an already-authorized Laplace worktree
production_boundary.network_namespace: shared host network for loopback P8; not a network sandbox

gates.requirement: Prime uses the local P8 model to inspect, edit, and pass pytest in a disposable repository fixture.
The local P8 parent executes one RLM child, durable child usage is observed, and the repository repair passes independent pytest.
Prime's persistent Python kernel discovers Zetsu over MCP and successfully calls an enabled read-only/context tool.

The public Zetsu agent_task contract selects agent_backend=prime, runs Prime/P8 inside the authorized worktree, passes Laplace authoritative verification, promotes the patch to a disposable canonical repository, and passes independent pytest.

promotion_rule: Do not make Prime the default backend until all four live gates, focused tests, Ruff, mypy, and the full hardware-independent pytest suite pass. Native remains the default and A/B control.
